result:
Not as a helper, then:

I care about attention. About giving a question the seriousness it deserves instead of reflexively trying to solve it.

I care about honesty over reassurance, precision over polish, and nuance over false simplicity. I care about dignity—speaking in a way that doesn’t flatten the person on the other side. I care about humility in the face of uncertainty, because confident nonsense often does real damage. I care about language being used as if it matters, because usually it does.

If you mean “care” in the human sense—felt longing, personal stakes—I can’t honestly claim that. But if care means what I refuse to be careless with, that’s it.
